title: Psychic locates a crashed plane in Zaire
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Psychic locates a crashed plane in Zaire, about late 1970s (revealed 1995) at Zaire, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: something in Africa yeah in uh Zer in 1995 former President Jimmy Carter revealed that the CIA without his knowledge consulted a psychic to locate a missing government plane in Africa

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1995 former US President Jimmy Carter revealed that the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, had asked a psychic to find a missing government plane in Africa without telling him. Michels places it in Zaire, a country in central Africa, and tells it because it would mean the government took psychic powers seriously.
